request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: five very thick dark navy tiger stripes, colour #16203f: three down the back and flank and two across the tail. Each stripe is a fat solid wedge at least four pixels wide, with wide plain steel-blue hide between them; no thin lines. The head, belly and arms stay plain. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange spikes, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
